content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: autoscaler-latency-high for service=prod-router

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PDXXXX123 fired (severity: P3). Notified rotation: @alex, @sam

alex: ack'd. I'm on it. heading to logs now :eyes:

sam: ack also. grabbing flamegraph from last 5m

alex: quick check — CPU/OOMs? I don't see OOMs on the node. Proxy p95 spiked ~3.2s -> 5.8s at 15:12:17

maria: jumping in — looks tied to the dedicated autoscaler chatter in us-west-2. small scale-up storms.

lee: @maria any visible customer impact? dashboards look green for error rate

maria: no 5xx increase, only latency. likely tail latency due to scale-concurrency coupling.

sam: dumping recent logs:
```
[15:12:12] router: accept req id=abc123 duration=3200ms
[15:12:13] router: scale_event trigger=scale_up group=gpu-reserve reason=queue_depth
[15:12:15] router: accept req id=def456 duration=5800ms
```

alex: thanks. I'm going to bump the autoscaler cool-down to blunt the churn temporarily.

maria: +1. Can we silence PD for the noise window? auto-resolve is already set to 10m but it's spiking repeatedly.

sam: created a temporary alert silence for 20m via `pd silence PDXXXX123 --duration 20m` :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Silence created (20m) by sam

incident-bot: Note: alert fired 3x in last 6m. Possible flapping. Will auto-resolve if metrics drop below threshold.

alex: applied short cool-down patch to autoscaler config (rolling restart):
```
autoscaler:
  scale_down_cooldown: 60s -> 90s
  burst_protection: true
```

maria: watching heatmap — kernel-level backlog cleared after config push. latency p95 falling from 5.8s -> 1.1s over next 2m

lee: good. customers unaffected; no open tickets.

sam: PagerDuty: PDXXXX123 auto-resolved at 15:14:58

pagerduty-bot: PDXXXX123 resolved (auto-resolve). Duration 2m41s

alex: closing the immediate chatter. leaving temporary silence and autoscaler change for follow-up.

maria: follow-up action: file runbook note and open infra ticket to evaluate autoscaler hysteresis and prefilling pools.

sam: ticket created: INFRA-789 — investigation & longer-term mitigation. assigning to @maria

maria: ack. I'll take first-pass. tagging perf/infra for visibility. :spiral_calendar:

lee: thanks team. no customer impact, marking as no-customer-impact in the incident record.

incident-bot: Thread summary: transient autoscaler-induced latency spikes -> repeated PD fires -> team applied cool-down + silence -> auto-resolve. Follow-up INFRA-789 assigned to maria.

alex: fyi, will monitor for 24h and rollback if any regressions. :eyes:

maria: adding log pointers and graphs to INFRA-789. done.

sam: nice quick mitigation. wrapping up.
